pages.text: Astral Sorcery Lightwell Lightwell$(br2)$(l:arcanearchives:items/rawquartz)Raw Radiant Quartz$(/l) generates Liquid Starlight. It is long lasting, but low production.$(br2)$(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) also generates Liquid Starlight. It is a bit more efficient than Raw Radiant Quartz.

$(l:arcanearchives:gems/rivertear)Rivertears$(/l) generates water at about 2 buckets per tick. It is effectively infinite, but due to technical limits there is a ridiculously small chance of shattering.$(br2)$(l:arcanearchives:gems/mountaintear)Mountaintears$(/l) generates lava at a moderate rate. It is effectively infinite, but due to technical limits there is a ridiculously small chance of shattering.
Arcane Arsenal is not enabled; some features for this section are not present.
